excerpt: The Business Benefits of Global Recruitment: Why Expanding Your Talent Pool Matters Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. The Canadian skilled trades sector is facing a critical skills gap as industries evolve, technologies advance, and experienced workers retire. In 2025, micro-credentials have emerged as a game-changing solution—offering rapid, targeted training that aligns closely with employer needs. For both job seekers and employers in trades like construction, manufacturing, and clean technology, micro-credentials are transforming how talent is developed, recognized, and recruited.
